name: Night shift
source:
At the end of your night shift a strange woman calls to inform you that you are stuck in a time loop, the only way to escape is to find Sam, another lost soul that wander in the infinity of the building. 

It is up to you to find the clues of how to escape. The people guiding you are untrustworthy and the world around you might not be real, don't lose your head.

[edited from [url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/ns]itch.io[/url]]
